main.remarks: This interface defines the operational contracts of the ToolGenericHostBuilder.

property.name: Builder
property.remarks: The managed for application-level host composition.

property.name: HostBuilder
property.remarks: The managed for application-level host composition when host-builder mode is active.

method.name: ConfigureToolGenericHost
method.remarks: Applies configuration to the built instance after construction.

method.name: ConfigureToolGenericHostAsync
method.param: Async configuration action for the built ToolGenericHost.
method.remarks: Applies configuration to the built instance after construction while preserving ordered execution with synchronous ToolGenericHost-configuration actions.

method.name: BuildGenericHostOpenFactory
method.summary: Build the ToolGenericHost using a factory delegate.
method.param: Factory delegate that constructs the ToolGenericHost.

method.name: BuildGenericHostAsyncOpenFactory
method.summary: Build the ToolGenericHost Async using a factory delegate.
method.param: Factory delegate that constructs the ToolGenericHost.

method.name: ConnectWithApplication
method.summary: Connect the built ToolGenericHost to managed application services.
method.remarks: Registers a shared in managed application services when a builder-owned Tool service provider is used. This registration is skipped for an externally supplied Tool service provider.

method.name: LinkLifetime
method.summary: Link the Tool host lifetime to managed application services.
method.remarks: Registers the host's shared in managed application services when a builder-owned Tool service provider is used. This registration is skipped for an externally supplied Tool service provider.

method.name: UseConsoleLifetime
method.summary: Use console lifetime behavior with the builder-owned Tool service provider.
method.remarks: When an external Tool service provider is supplied, the builder uses the host's default lifetime instead.

method.name: UseBuilderSettings
method.remarks: Uses a new Empty HostApplication Builder.

method.name: UseFullBuilderArgs
method.remarks: Uses a new Full HostApplication Builder.

method.name: UseHostBuilder
method.remarks: Removes Builder and uses a new default HostBuilder.

method.name: UseFullBuilder
method.remarks: Uses a new Full HostApplication Builder.
